path_policy:
(deny file-read* file-write* (subpath "/golden/state"))
(deny file-read* file-write* (subpath "/golden/home/.corsia"))
(deny file-read* file-write* (subpath "/golden/home/.config/safehouse"))
(deny file-read* file-write* (subpath "/golden/state/keys"))
(deny file-read* file-write* (subpath "/golden/state/browser-profile"))

(deny file-write* (literal "/golden"))
(deny file-write* (literal "/golden/home"))
(deny file-write* (literal "/golden/home/.corsia"))
(deny file-write* (literal "/golden/state"))
;; CORSIA MANAGED BROWSER BOUNDARY
(deny network-outbound (remote tcp "*:39400"))
(deny network-bind (local tcp "*:39400"))
(deny network-outbound (remote tcp "*:39401"))

(deny file-read* file-write* (subpath "/golden/browser-sockets"))

(deny file-read* file-write* (literal "/golden/state/profile.sb"))
(deny file-write* (literal "/private/tmp/corsia-restart"))

(deny file-write* (regex #"^/golden/home/Library/LaunchAgents/[^/]*[Cc][Oo][Rr][Ss][Ii][Aa][^/]*\.plist$"))
